title: Privacy & cookies
html:
Privacy & cookies

Updated October 27, 2026

Hosting

This site is prepared for Hostinger hosting. The hosting provider may process request information, including IP addresses and browser details, to deliver and secure the website.

Private administration

The owner signs in with an email address and password. A signed session cookie, backed by a revocable database session record, grants access for up to eight hours and expires after 30 minutes of inactivity. The cookie is HttpOnly and uses Secure on production HTTPS. A database counter limits repeated login attempts. The password is verified against a salted hash configured by the owner; no public account registration is offered.

Content and media

Articles, categories and uploaded images are stored in the publisher’s MySQL database. Uploaded images become publicly accessible when used as a published article cover. Owner activity records include publishing actions and article identifiers. Draft articles are restricted to the owner.

Comments

Comment buttons are not shown on cards. If the comment feature is used, submitted names, text, article identifiers, dates and moderation status are stored in MySQL. Only approved comments are returned publicly. New public comment submissions are disabled. Existing comments remain available to the owner for moderation. Do not submit sensitive information.

Browser preferences

Cards no longer offer likes, dislikes or saved posts. Older browser-local preferences can be cleared with the control below.

Advertising and analytics

This version does not install advertising scripts or analytics trackers. If these services are added, the publisher must update these disclosures and configure any required consent controls before enabling them.

Contact

The publisher still needs to provide a public privacy contact before launch. This notice must be reviewed against the final hosting configuration and services actually used.
